Frequently asked questions

Considered answers to common questions.

Is SEO still a sound investment now that people use AI assistants?

Yes. AI assistants and AI Overviews draw on the same web that search engines index. Strong SEO is the foundation for being cited in AI answers, and traditional search continues to drive the majority of website traffic.

What is generative engine optimization?

Generative engine optimization (GEO) improves how often and how accurately AI systems such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity mention and cite your organization. It extends SEO with a focus on entities, citations and answer-ready content.

How do you measure visibility in AI answers?

We track a defined set of questions your customers ask across the major AI assistants and record how often your organization is mentioned, cited and recommended relative to competitors.

When should we expect to see results?

Technical improvements can show an effect within weeks. Content and authority work typically builds over three to six months. Your roadmap sets expectations and we report progress monthly.

Do you guarantee rankings or AI citations?

No reputable firm can. We commit to a transparent plan, measurable work each month and reporting tied to enquiries and revenue.

Can you work with our existing website and team?

Yes. We work with WordPress and most major platforms, and can implement changes directly or in collaboration with your developers and writers.
